hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Sort points primarily by x ascending and secondarily by y descending.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: For each point i, sweep through subsequent points j with y_j <= y_i.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: A pair (i, j) is valid if no previously visited point lies between them vertically; track the maximum y encountered so far.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting points followed by paired sweep with running maximum y tracking.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space beyond input sorting.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sort with tie-breaking on y descending to eliminate same-x interference.
